scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-image-budget.mjs dist
scripts.build:perf: tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir dist-perf && node scripts/check-image-budget.mjs dist-perf
scripts.photos:build: python scripts/optimize-images.py assets-source/photos public/photos --max-edge 2000 --thumb --manifest src/content/photos.generated.ts --format webp
scripts.projects:build: python scripts/optimize-images.py assets-source/projects public/projects --max-edge 2560 --thumb --thumb-edge 720 --quality 84 --exclude-prefix cert_ --manifest src/content/projects.generated.ts --manifest-export projects --manifest-type Project --manifest-command "npm run projects:build" --manifest-order asc --no-date-warning --format webp
scripts.projects:all: npm run projects:export && npm run projects:build
